Methodology

Each week, YouGov invites around 1,500 members of its opt-in panel to complete an online questionnaire. The respondents are selected to be representative of American adult citizens and the data is weighted to represent the country according to gender, age, race, education and voting behaviour. To track the results of YouGov’s polling over time, The Economist aggregates survey data each week and fits a line of best fit. # Republican support for Trump has fallen as Democrats hold a big lead among enthusiastic midterms voters

David Montgomery-August 18, 2026

According to this week's Economist / YouGov Poll, about one-third (35%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Donald Trump's job performance as president, and 61% disapprove. That's a net job approval of -26, up slightly from -29 last week.
